trailhead.name: Albanita Trail trailhead at the end of paved Monache Jeep Road (FR 21S36A), Smith Mountain

identifiedBy.fact: signed trailhead at end of Monache Jeep Rd; old road signed Albanita Trail; 3.3 mi RT, 1100 ft gain

notes: Opened kernriversierra (this route, same start as before) and USFS Albanita Trail page (trail begins off FR 21S36A, no coordinate, no named trailhead). No allowed coordinate: Trailforks lists 36.12804,-118.26063 for FR 21S36 trailhead but that is not an allowed placement source; USFS Blackrock Trailhead is a different place. Name only.

identifiedBy.fact: started at Crown Valley trailhead just south of Wishon Reservoir, passed Statham Meadow, Spanish/Geraldine Lakes saddle at 7:15a, left trail for the North Ridge

notes: Bob Burd report opened (Crown Valley, Statham Meadow, Geraldine saddle, north ridge match route text). Search summary only (not opened, SummitPost 403) says Rancheria is an alternate start that joins the same trail; Crown Valley is the one matching the Statham Meadow text. No coordinate from an allowed source; name only.

identifiedBy.fact: Taboose Pass trail, leave it before the pass, climb Striped from the basin; 2019 wacziarg report same (trailhead inferred from route), NE slope class 2

notes: Moderate. Opened wacziarg 2019 (Taboose, inferred not named), climber.org SPS listing (no route text). Search summary said a SummitPost page calls Taboose Pass the usual access (not opened, 403). Nothing opened names another start; Sawmill Pass has no route page. Earlier pass opened peaksforfreaks.

Nothing new. Search results (not opened, summaries only): PCT from Donner Summit trailhead (14.5 mi RT), Coldstream/Horseshoe Bend (10.4 mi RT), Olympic Valley. Z and B Johnson page too long and did not give the start in the part read. Several equal starts, route text 'reach the PCT' ties to none.

otherFacts.value: East Ridge mostly class 3 with detours; reported class 2-3

notes: Opened climber.org 2013/1844: party started at Horse Corral (Marvin Pass), 3 days, 25 mi to Glacier Lake, Triple Divide Pass, East Ridge. Search summaries also show Shepherd Pass/Symmes Creek and Road's End starts. No page calls any one the standard. Candidates: Horse Corral/Marvin Pass, Symmes Creek/Shepherd Pass, Road's End.

identifiedBy.fact: started at Whitney Portal, North Fork Lone Pine Creek trail, then toward Carillon-Cleaver col, crossed Tulainyo Lake, summit; 12.4 mi, 7,750 ft

notes: Opened themtsarecalling: Whitney Portal start; note it leaves the Mountaineers Route trail before Lower Boy Scout Lake (Cleaver col variant) but same trailhead. Route text itself says Mountaineers Route, which starts at Whitney Portal. Only one start in use. Single placement (USFS).

Nothing new. Wikipedia opened: no access info. Earlier pass: climber.org 2007/1611 used Green Creek via Virginia Pass (one party); search summaries show Twin Lakes/Mono Village side (Horse Creek/Peeler Lake) and Virginia Lakes also plausible. No standard route page opened. Candidates: Green Creek, Twin Lakes (Mono Village), Virginia Lakes.

otherFacts.value: easy class 2 via saddle and SW ridge/slopes

notes: Opened Burd report: started at Twin Lakes day-use lot via Barney Lake and Seavey Pass (west face), says easiest is trail to a saddle then SW Ridge. Another party came over Horse Creek Pass. Search summaries: Virginia Lakes (Benson Pass), Tuolumne PCT/Rodgers Lake. Multi-day from every start, no page ties 'standard route' to one.
